payload.posture: Read Ephesians 4:25–32 as evidence about the Spirit, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states ephesians 4:25–32 names God’s Spirit within a source unit where the Spirit is grieved; the wording centers attention on “Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
